name: General contract
description: Any contract or lease that doesn't match a more specific type
example_questions: What happens if I leave early?

summary_fields.name: parties
summary_fields.label: Parties
summary_fields.description: Who is bound by the contract, with their role

summary_fields.name: key_dates
summary_fields.label: Key dates
summary_fields.description: Start, end, renewal and notice deadlines

summary_fields.name: payments
summary_fields.label: Payments
summary_fields.description: Rent, salary, fees, deposits and amounts

summary_fields.name: obligations
summary_fields.label: Your obligations
summary_fields.description: Main things the signer must do

risk_categories.label: Early termination / penalties
risk_categories.description: Fees, penalties or lost money if the signer ends the contract early

risk_categories.label: Automatic renewal
risk_categories.description: The contract renews by itself unless the signer acts, often with a long notice deadline

risk_categories.label: Deposit / fee forfeiture
risk_categories.description: The signer can lose a deposit or prepaid fees, especially regardless of actual damage

risk_categories.label: One-sided liability / indemnity
risk_categories.description: The signer covers the other party's losses or carries responsibilities that normally belong to the other party

risk_categories.label: Rent / price increases
risk_categories.description: The other party can raise rent, salary deductions or prices, especially at any time or by any amount

risk_categories.label: Non-compete / restrictive covenants
risk_categories.description: Limits on where the signer can work, live, or what they can do during or after the contract

risk_categories.label: Notice periods
risk_categories.description: Long, strict or unusual notice requirements the signer must meet

risk_categories.label: Unilateral changes
risk_categories.description: The other party can change the terms without the signer's agreement
